description: A bright, sprite-driven Phaser snake game with three bounty trails, responsive swipe, keyboard, and on-screen steering, animated growth, collision feedback, local best scores, and complete free-play restart and recovery loops. New wallet-funded runs remain gated until the deployed reward pool and full Morpheus settlement path have production evidence; historical recovery stays available in the runtime.
description_zh: 明亮、资源化的 Phaser 贪吃蛇游戏，拥有三条赏金蛇道、灵敏的滑动、键盘与屏幕方向控制、成长动画、碰撞反馈、本地最佳成绩，以及完整的免费重玩与恢复流程。新的钱包付费对局将在已部署奖励池和完整 Morpheus 结算路径获得生产证据后开放；历史对局恢复能力仍保留在运行时中。
name: Snake Bounty

operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a trail, steer the illustrated snake, collect bounty fruit, grow to the target, and save your local best. Free play never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Snake Bounty

aa.description: The guest-first release does not request a wallet or account-abstraction signature.

oracle.description: Free local play makes no oracle request. Historical recovery remains available, while new paid runs stay gated until a funded end-to-end settlement has production evidence.

tee.description: Free local play makes no TEE request. Morpheus-backed paid starts are not advertised until live pool and settlement validation is complete.
